method: Pearson r over 32 club-seasons from one dated standings capture. n is published on every row. No market number, no third-party number and no price is used, so every value here is computable from the official page alone.
note: These are covariates of published season aggregates. They are NOT bet correlations: a bet correlation needs joint outcomes across markets, and that requires a graded sample this repository does not have.

rows.interpretation: scoring and conceding are uncorrelated across clubs
SCEPTICAL CHECK: a club that has played more games has more points; this correlation is a schedule artefact and is published to show the artefact, not as a signal
